title.zh: Aptos基金会提出代币经济学改革方案，设定21亿枚APT硬供应上限并永久锁定质押2.1亿枚APT
title.en: Aptos Unveils Tokenomics Overhaul: 210M APT to Be Permanently Locked, Staking Re

current_state.zh: The Aptos Foundation unveiled a tokenomics reform plan setting a 2.1 billion APT hard supply cap, halving staking rewards to 2.6%, raising transaction fees 10x, permanently locking and staking 210 million APT, and exploring buybacks in an effort to make APT deflationary.
current_state.en: The Aptos Foundation unveiled a tokenomics reform plan setting a 2.1 billion APT hard supply cap, halving staking rewards to 2.6%, raising transaction fees 10x, permanently locking and staking 210 million APT, and exploring buybacks in an effort to make APT deflationary.

updates.title_zh: Aptos 公布代币经济改革方案：2.1 亿枚 APT 将永久锁定，质押奖励减半
updates.title_en: Aptos Unveils Tokenomics Overhaul: 210M APT to Be Permanently Locked, Staking Re
updates.what_changed_zh:
Aptos 基金会提出了一项 APT 代币经济改革方案，拟将年度质押奖励从 5.19% 下调至 2.6%、将 Gas 费提高十倍，并将总供应量上限设为 21 亿枚 APT。根据该方案，基金会将永久锁定并质押 2.1 亿枚 APT（约占当前供应量的 18%），相关运营支出由质押奖励而非出售代币来承担。

基金会表示，这些调整旨在减少代币增发并增加销毁量，可能使 APT 具备通缩属性。未来的生态拨款将与业绩里程碑挂钩；随着首个四年解锁周期在 2026 年 10 月结束，年度化的代币解锁量预计将下降 60%。

上述措施目前仍属提案，尚未落地执行。此外，一项由现金储备和未来收入提供资金的回购计划也正在考虑之中。
updates.what_changed_en: Aptos Foundation proposed cutting staking rewards from 5.19% to 2.6%, raising gas fees tenfold, capping supply at 2.1 billion APT, permanently locking and staking 210 million APT, and tying grants to milestones while considering a buyback to cut emissions and make APT potentially deflationary.

updates.background_zh: Aptos 主网于 2022 年 10 月 12 日上线，APT 用于支付手续费、质押和治理，验证者通过权益证明（PoS）BFT 模型维护网络安全。新的 APT 可通过质押奖励产生，同时部分交易手续费会被销毁。APT 采用归属（vesting）释放安排，份额分配给社区、核心贡献者、基金会、投资者和质押奖励，完整释放计划延续至 2050 年。
updates.background_en: Aptos mainnet launched on October 12, 2022, and APT is used for fees, staking and governance, with validators securing the network through a proof-of-stake BFT model. New APT can be created through staking rewards, while part of transaction fees is burned. APT follows a vesting schedule with allocations to the community, core contributors, the Foundation, investors and staking rewards, with the full schedule extending into 2050.
updates.market_impact_zh: 受此影响最直接的领域是 APT 现货与衍生品交易场所，以及质押和验证者服务：该提案通过供应与奖励渠道直接作用于代币增发和质押收益率；若获通过，解锁计划缩减和潜在回购将影响流通供应与抛压。
updates.market_impact_en: APT spot and derivatives venues, along with staking and validator services, are the segments most directly exposed: the proposal targets issuance and staking yield through the supply and reward channel, while the reduced unlock schedule and the possible buyback would affect circulating supply and sell-side pressure if adopted.
